summary: Auth compatibility with installs of the earlier library entry (Greptile PR #2450 round 2 P1): env fallbacks in precedence order CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_API_KEY, each legacy name with a one-line deprecation notice on stderr; saved legacy bearer_auth / api_key keys (bearer_auth first) in the resolved config file, the pre-paths legacy config and the credentials file are honoured and rewritten to crm_bearer_auth once (cliutil.AtomicWritePrivateFile, the original kept as <file>.legacy-auth.bak), with a one-line notice; a file that is not regular or fails cliutil.VerifyCredsPerms is never rewritten; a file that cannot be rewritten is honoured for the run with a notice; no secret value is printed. Hand-authored internal/config/legacy_auth.go, called from Load in the generated config.go.
reason: The 4.34.2 reprint reads only CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and crm_bearer_auth; existing installs that use the earlier env names or saved keys would lose authentication on upgrade.
validated_outcome: TestLegacyAuthEnvPrecedence (6 rows), TestLegacyAuthConfigMigratesOnceAndIsIdempotent (bearer_auth, api_key, both, current already set; backup equals the original; a second load changes nothing and prints nothing), TestLegacyAuthCredentialsFileMigrates, TestLegacyAuthNeverRewritesAnUntrustedFile and TestLegacyAuthUnwritableFileIsHonouredForTheRun pass and assert no secret in any notice; the FULL live gate passes with CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and again with only CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH.
